title: MembershipChanged, as Events reads it
description: Published by Auth & Users (farol.auth-users, routing key membership.changed), consumed from events.auth-users-events into the membership copy (spec D2, D3). This is what Events relies on; the producer's own contract (#191) wins where they differ. Full state with a version: Events upserts its copy, ignores a version not newer than the one it has and keeps Removed rows (API outline §7.3). status is optional and read as Active when it is missing, in case #198 drops MembershipStatus (spec §4). A message without what this schema requires is dead-lettered with the reason (spec D2). Unknown fields are ignored.

status.description: Optional: read as Active when missing
